message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to log you out of the system.
message.reasoning: The user says "I need to log out the system with my credentials." They want to log out? But they say "with my credentials" which might mean they want to authenticate first? Actually they want to log out the system with their credentials. That seems contradictory: logging out typically doesn't require credentials. Maybe they want to log in? Or maybe they want to log out from all sessions? The instruction says we have a function user_authentication_login. There's no logout function. So we cannot do logout. We can only call login. But the user wants to log out. We can't fulfill that request because there's no function. According to policy, we should respond that we cannot help with that.
